_comment: mail.summarize (MailSafeSummary.swift): a message body summarised FOR an agent by a separate, tool-less model on the user's Mac. The body never reaches the agent. Cost is $0 by design: junk is refused before any fetch, only LOCAL models run, and each message is summarised once (shared cache with AI Inbox's Summarise button).
_providers: Which LOCAL kinds may run at all: an allowlist, nothing else. ORDER is no longer this list's: since Phase KN (2026-09-29) the mail.summary AI job's card decides (content/ai-jobs/jobs.json + the user's Best Quality | Lowest Cost choice on this Mac). Anything not local here is ignored on purpose: a mail body does not leave the Mac to save a click.
_maxBodyChars: Sanitised body text handed to the model (clamped 500-12000). Apple's on-device model has a ~4k-token window.
_skip: Never summarised unless the caller passes force:true. Gmail's own classifier already ran; paying anything to read a newsletter is the waste this file exists to prevent.
